name: Qwen Image Edit — multiple character angles
description: Upload one character (or any subject) and get 8 camera angles of it in a single run — the model re-renders the same subject from each viewpoint. The 8 default views are close-up, wide-angle lens, aerial view, low-angle, and 45° & 90° turns to the left and right, but you can edit any of them: the model follows a 'Turn/Rotate the camera to…' grammar, e.g. 'Rotate the camera 180 degrees to show the back view' or 'Turn the camera to a profile side view'. Works best with a single clear subject on a simple background.
